original_description: Your AI design partner, right in ChatGPT. Generate logos, images, presentations, and videos from the chat, or upload your own image to edit. Just describe what you need, and Wixel generates professional designs that you can download and use right away, or fine-tune in the Wixel editor.
summary_ja: ロゴ・画像・プレゼン・動画を作り、画像編集やエディターでの調整を行う。
limitations: 実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
